market.what: Mn circuit in black-mass hydromet (D2EHPA SX + MnSO4 crystallisation), world
market.method: ~25% of ~$440M separation spend (Mn ~60 kg/t BM, saponified D2EHPA). bottom-up est.: ~600 kt Ni/Co black mass refined (120 kt Ni at ~20% Ni) x ~$735/t separation cost [opex ~$340/t: NaOH saponification ~440 kg x $368/t, strip acid ~540 kg x $123/t, Na2SO4 handling, organic loss; capex charge ~$395/t: 35% SX share x 15%/yr of ~$5k/t-yr Asia or ~$26k/t-yr West (Li-Cycle $0.85-1B/35 kt)]

value.logic: direct battery-grade MnSO4 via selective binder: 40% cut of $110M = $44M + recover ~10 kt Mn now lost (~40 kt Mn in feed vs 14 kt recovered, est.) x $2.7k/t = $27M
value.revenue_logic: $70M x 3 (2032; Mn recycling grows faster) x 6% adoption x 35% capture
value.margin_logic: specialty precipitant/binder; Mn is low value, caps price

trend.drivers: recycled Mn 12 kt (2024) -> 130 kt (2034); Mn-rich cathodes (LMFP, LMR) grow
trend.deadline: EU Battery Reg recovery targets 31 Dec 2027 (no Mn-specific target)

competition.notes: D2EHPA SX gives 99.6% MnSO4 in 3 stages (Chalmers) but co-extracts 3-5% Co/Li/Ni; Mn sells at only ~$860-900/t MnSO4

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom selective Mn precipitant/binder, 3 variants
lab.test: precipitation from real NMC leach, MnSO4 purity vs battery-grade spec by ICP-OES/MS, Co/Ni/Li co-loss; university hydromet lab
lab.logic: synth 6 wk ~$15-20k CRO; test 6 wk ~200 ICP x $40-50 + crystallisation ~$3k

sale.gates: bench 3-6 mo; recycler pilot 6-12 mo; MnSO4 qualification by pCAM buyer 6-12 mo
